study: Native-code eICU hospital-held-out prescription-method and feedback comparison
registration: After v24 source/coverage audit and before any eICU model score
source_partition: Keep the exact v24 hospital hash and patient-overlap exclusions; do not move hospitals or patients between splits
analysis_cohort: From v24, exclude an entire stay if any order in [360,720) has absent/nonpositive/noninteger HICL. Retain zero-target stays. This is a retrospective label-completeness/documentation-selected cohort, not all clinical stays.
sampling: Sort stays within each split by sha256('rxrsi-eicu-v25:'+patientunitstayid). Keep first40000 train,2000 proposal,2000 guard and all eligible test stays. Initial8000 training stays are fixed; remaining32000 shuffle per seed.
inputs: Only age decade/gender, latest24 prior medication records with order offset in[-1080,360), and latest32 distinct lab-name/unit measurements drawn in[-1080,360] and revised by360. Never input hospital/patient IDs, cancellation/discharge outcomes, future orders or untimed diagnosis fields. Medication storage times and full field histories are unavailable.
lab_selection: Latest draw per normalized lab-name/unit, ties by revised offset then numeric lab ID; select32 latest distinct pairs. Finite numeric values only.
labels: Native positive-integer HICL codes; not an assertion of RxNorm/ATC/ingredient equivalence. Freeze top512 codes by initial8k stay frequency, ties by code. Include out-of-vocabulary GT codes in recall.
normalization: Lowercase, trim and collapse whitespace; preserve dosage/frequency strings without clinical unit conversion. Missing attributes remain null. Score complete observed joint tuples and report completion coverage separately.
features: Freeze on initial8k: word TF-IDF max6000 unigram/bigram, character TF-IDF max5000 ngram3..5, and typed prior-code/route/frequency plus top64 lab-name/unit numeric states. Robust numeric scales use initial8k only. Word+typed concatenation is row-normalized.
policy: Independent logistic SGD,alpha1e-5,exactly60epochs,tol=None,reinitialize each round. All three arms within seed share cases/order/epochs. Initial model shared.
feedback: Same as v23: accepted error-arm parent predicts each new block before its labels update the model. Weight1+3*(1-caseF1) on reachable fixed codes; empty/empty quality1. Persist weights; normalize cumulative mean1. Permuted control shuffles the exact new-block vector with seed*100+round.
order_tool: Global joint-tuple defaults plus conditional SGD on at most8 frequent observed tuples per code (support>=10,records>=80,>=2tuples),alpha1e-4,max_iter40,tol1e-3. Shared by arms within seed/round, fitted only to currently seen cases. Rejected states retain previous policy and tool.
selection: Proposal chooses threshold on mean drug/complete-order microF1. Separate guard promotes improved composite only if neither endpoint drops more than0.002. Guard is reused development data.
output_budget: At most20 distinct codes, one observed joint tuple per code, same frozen vocabulary in all methods
static_budget: Word and character controls use the same alpha and exact60epochs. Ensemble weights0/.25/.5/.75/1 and seven thresholds selected only on proposal. Retrieval and prevalence select the same thresholds. These controls have disclosed different total search/fit budgets; feedback-arm causal comparisons have exact matched exposure budgets.
ablations: freeze initial order tool in selected error-priority state
freeze initial policy in final shared order tool
test_policy: All three seeds/arms/static selections must freeze before any test prediction. Report final methods, raw and accepted checkpoints; no eICU test-based model selection.
statistics: Independent prediction recount; paired hospital-cluster and patient-cluster bootstrap2000draws, seed mean/sampleSD, repairs/regressions, zero-target and nonempty-target strata, empty rate and complete-order coverage. Descriptive intervals; no multiplicity adjustment.
fixed: LLM weights (no LLM/API in this study)
claim_boundary: External dataset with hospitals held out within eICU training/evaluation, not zero-shot MIMIC transfer or autonomous LLM evolution. Native-code/field protocol differs from MIMIC and published ATC benchmarks. Ground-truth order agreement is not clinical safety. Restricted data and models stay local.
